_comment: PayneSDD dogfood config. Copy to .claude/settings.json (git-ignored) to activate the Step 4 gate as an enforced Claude Code Stop-hook. PAYNE_TEST_CMD here runs THIS repo's self-check (syntax of the shell hooks); in your own project swap it for your real test command, e.g. 'npm test', 'pytest -q', 'swift test'. Then `touch .payne-active` to arm the gate for a task, `rm .payne-active` when done.
